errorBoundary.title: Configuration error
errorBoundary.body: The parent console could not start due to an unexpected internal error. This is not a normal "backend not reachable yet" condition -- please report this to the PCA team.

common.errorGeneric: We could not load this data. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.honestNote: Each capability is shown with its own real status. We never claim full protection when any capability is limited.

rbac.deniedBody: Your role ({{role}}) does not permit this action. This is enforced by the family authority gateway, not just hidden in the UI.
rbac.viewOnlyBanner: You have Viewer access -- read-only. Editing controls are disabled for your role.

stepUp.title: Re-authenticate to continue
stepUp.body: This is a sensitive family-authority action and requires step-up authentication.

trustedBrowser.title: Trusted browser status
trustedBrowser.BROWSER_NOT_TRUSTED: This browser is not yet trusted with family decryption authority.
trustedBrowser.PAIRING_REQUIRED: Signed in to your account. Pairing this browser with the family is required before you can see family data.
trustedBrowser.PAIRING_PENDING: Pairing request sent. Waiting for parent approval on an already-trusted device.
trustedBrowser.TRUSTED: This browser is trusted and can decrypt family data.
trustedBrowser.EPOCH_STALE: This browser's trust is out of date (stale epoch). Some data may not be shown until it re-syncs.
trustedBrowser.REVOKED: This browser's trust has been revoked. Pair again to regain access.
trustedBrowser.note: Signing in to the account service does NOT by itself grant family decryption authority -- those are separate trust boundaries.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing Messages
wellbeing.supervisionNote: Some suggestions are hazard-adjacent and may need adult supervision before enabling.
wellbeing.privateNote: Custom children's messages are private child-related content -- not server-readable in production.
wellbeing.noFullScreenNote: No ordinary wellbeing message previews as a full-screen interruption; impersonation/system-warning-style behaviour is prohibited.

family.removeMemberNotice: Removing a non-owner parent ends that member's family access. It is separate from removing a child device and from Delete Now.

deviceEnrollment.title: Add a child device
deviceEnrollment.protectedModeNote: Protected mode is only a REQUEST at invitation time -- it does not itself confirm Device Owner provisioning succeeded on the child device.
deviceEnrollment.consentBody: Review this monitoring summary before PCA creates the one-time enrollment token for the new device.
deviceEnrollment.consentMonitored: You may see your children's category-level app and website activity, screen-time and break status, protection status, requests, and configured trust-zone alerts.
deviceEnrollment.consentNotMonitored: PCA does not receive message or call content, camera images, exact browsing history, or precise live location unless a separate feature for your children's devices is enabled. PCA infrastructure cannot read encrypted activity from your children's devices.
deviceEnrollment.tokenRevealBody: This link and token are shown only once. They will not be shown again after you close this panel or reload the page -- if you need it again, create a new invitation.
deviceEnrollment.qrCodeAlt: QR code for the child device's enrollment link
deviceEnrollment.qrCodeHint: Scan this with the child's device camera or the PCA app to speed up enrollment.
deviceEnrollment.fallbackCodeBody: This short code identifies only this opaque invitation. It is a display aid, not a replacement for the full enrollment token.
deviceEnrollment.tokenNeverAgain: For security, this token cannot be retrieved again. Send it to the child's device now.
deviceEnrollment.fingerprintCompareInstruction: Compare both fingerprints against the ones shown on the child device's own setup screen before confirming. Do not confirm if they do not match exactly.
deviceEnrollment.invitationSecurityNotice: Enrollment links and fallback codes are short-lived and single-use. Treat them as sensitive setup material and send them only to the intended child device.
deviceEnrollment.pairingSecurityNotice: Pairing adds the device keys to the family trust set. Confirm only after both fingerprints match exactly; do not treat a requested protection mode as proof that managed provisioning succeeded.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: The server denied this action for your account.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state (e.g. already paired or revoked).
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests -- please wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the PCA service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.sessionUnavailable: Device enrollment is temporarily unavailable (no service session available).
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

requestsPage.title: Requests
requestsPage.decisionNotice: Each decision is made by an authorized parent role and recorded for this child. A pending child request is not an approval.

bonusTime.grantExplanation: Grant extra screen time to a child directly, up to {{max}} minutes per grant. This goes through the same approval, bound, and audit checks as responding to a child's own request.

grantError.NOT_AN_INTEGER: Minutes must be a whole number.
grantError.TOO_HIGH: A single bonus grant cannot exceed 120 minutes.

counterOfferError.NOT_AN_INTEGER: Minutes must be a whole number.
counterOfferError.TOO_HIGH: A single bonus grant cannot exceed 120 minutes.
counterOfferError.NOT_SHORTER: A counter-offer must be shorter than what the child asked for.

installApproval.requestOnlyNotice: This device cannot block installs -- approving or denying only records the family's decision; it does not change what is installed on the device.

offline.appOfflineNote: You're offline. The app shell still works, but data cannot refresh until you reconnect.
offline.staleDataNote: Remote data may be stale -- this console cannot currently confirm what is happening on the device.
offline.protectionContinuesNote: Local protection continues on the device using its last-applied policy; it is not disabled by this device being unreachable.
offline.pendingDeliveryNote: A new policy change is pending delivery and will apply once the device reconnects.
offline.editWillSyncWhenReconnected: You're offline. This edit is saved locally as a draft and will sync once you reconnect.
offline.requiresTrustedBrowser: Signing and queuing a policy change while offline requires a trusted browser and is not yet available (pending security review).

reconnect.relayUnreachable: Back online, but the sync service is still unreachable. Retrying automatically.
reconnect.failed: Reconnect sync did not complete. Will retry on the next connectivity change.

serviceAuth.unauthorizedFamilyScope: This account is not authorized for the requested family scope.
serviceAuth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
serviceAuth.networkError: Could not reach the PCA account service. Check your connection and try again.

webProtection.offlineNotice: You're offline -- changes cannot be sent to this device right now.
webProtection.pendingOffline: This browser is offline; the change was not sent.
webProtection.allowlistEmpty: No sites are on the always-allow list.

subscription.freeStarterExplain: Additional managed devices beyond your Free Starter allowance may require a paid increase, priced at the time you request it.
subscription.overLimitDevices: Your children's devices exceed your managed-device limit. Existing devices remain enrolled and functional, but you cannot enroll a new device until you are back within your entitlement.
subscription.overLimitMembers: Your family is over your parent-member limit. Existing members remain in the family, but you cannot add a new one until you are back within your entitlement.
subscription.paymentProviderUnavailable: Online payment is not available yet. This action is disabled until PCA's payment provider integration is live -- no charge can be started right now.

increaseDevices.title: Increase managed device allowance
increaseDevices.invalidTarget: Enter a whole number greater than your current limit ({{current}}).
increaseDevices.awaitingAdminQuote: Your requested quantity does not have a standard price. It has been sent for a pricing review -- you'll be notified with the exact price once a quote is ready. Payment is not possible until then.
increaseDevices.quoteExpired: This quote has expired. Cancel this request and submit a new one to get a current price.
increaseDevices.confirmingPayment: We're confirming your payment. This can take a moment -- your allowance will update automatically once payment is confirmed.
increaseDevices.approved: Payment confirmed. Your managed-device allowance has been increased. You are now using {{used}} of {{limit}} managed devices.
increaseDevices.chooseTarget: Choose a new total managed-device limit

increaseMembers.title: Increase parent member allowance
increaseMembers.neverBillable: Parent-member increases are never priced or charged -- they are reviewed and decided directly, at no charge.
increaseMembers.invalidTarget: Enter a whole number greater than your current limit ({{current}}).
increaseMembers.approved: Your request was approved. Your parent-member limit is now {{limit}}.

invoices.title: Invoices and receipts
invoices.notFound: This invoice could not be found.

checkoutReturn.title: Payment status
checkoutReturn.missingRequest: No request was specified for this payment return.
checkoutReturn.confirming: We're confirming your payment. Please don't close this page -- we'll update your allowance automatically once payment is confirmed by the server.
checkoutReturn.providerStatus: Payment provider status: {{status}} ({{amount}}) -- for reference only, not a confirmation.
checkoutReturn.confirmed: Payment confirmed. Your allowance has been updated.
checkoutReturn.failed: This request was denied. No payment was completed.

notifications.emailDestinationUnverified: This destination is saved but unverified. Email delivery remains disabled until verification is completed.
notifications.preferencesNotYetConnected: These delivery preferences are not yet backed by a server-side setting -- changing them here would not currently change what you receive, so they are shown read-only until that backend support exists.
notifications.payloadNote: Notification payloads never contain children's activity detail -- only a generic wake signal (docs/architecture/09_SECURITY_PRIVACY_E2EE.md Section 6).
notifications.commercialEmpty: You have no billing notifications yet.

devicesTable.removalNotice: Removing or revoking a child device changes family trust; it is separate from Delete Now. An offline device may remain pending until it reconnects.

audit.note: Audit entries never carry URLs, locations, activity detail, or recovery secrets.

screenTime.baselineWarning: This child's saved screen-time policy predates the mandatory 60/30 anti-gaming baseline and does not meet it. Update the values below and save to bring it into compliance.
screenTime.nightProtectionCommunication: Calls remain available during night protection.
screenTime.nightProtectionSms: SMS delivery remains available; Messages app use is not automatically unlocked.

location.safeZonePrivacy: PCA stores policy metadata only. It does not create a readable movement history.
location.safeZoneBoundaryNotice: Safe zones are optional entry/exit alerts for boundaries you define, not continuous live tracking. Unavailable location capability is reported as unavailable, not as no movement.
location.safeZoneEncryptionUnavailable: Safe-zone authoring is locked until this browser can create and verify the family-encrypted policy envelope. No readable location policy is sent to PCA.
location.safeZoneEmpty: No safe zone is configured for this child.
location.safeZoneSaveFailed: The safe zone could not be saved.

youtube.modeA: Mode A — normal YouTube app: app-usage duration only. PCA does not show an exact video list or the normal app's watch history.
youtube.modeB: Mode B — PCA-controlled player: only playback attempts and events started inside that player may be recorded locally. It is unavailable until separate terms, policy, and security review.
youtube.capabilityNotice: YouTube evidence is unavailable when the device or required permission cannot provide it; unavailable does not mean zero use.

export.description: An export is generated and encrypted entirely on this device; only the family's own key material can open it. Requesting one here records a pending export intake request with the service -- it is not yet a downloadable file (crypto-review pending).
export.generatedStatus: Export request accepted (ref {{exportId}}) -- pending crypto review, not yet a downloadable file.
export.scopeNotice: The export is limited to the authorized family data and retention scope shown at creation; it is not a complete copy of data PCA cannot lawfully or technically obtain.
export.externalCopyNotice: Once an encrypted export is saved outside PCA-managed storage, it is an external copy. PCA retention and Delete Now cannot remove it; the family must delete it from its chosen storage.

retention.description: Retention/deletion of children's activity is enforced locally by the device holding the plaintext; this screen sets the family-level policy value that devices honor.
retention.chooseWindow: Choose the retention window for this family
retention.chooseLocationWindow: Choose location-history retention (no longer than general retention)
retention.locationMustNotExceedGeneral: Location-history retention cannot exceed general activity retention.
retention.updatedStatus: Retention policy validated and audited: {{window}}. Devices apply this value locally.
retention.localEnforcementNotice: Each device enforces retention against the local copy it holds. Network access is not required for local expiry deletion, but a remote delivery or acknowledgement can remain pending while a device is offline.
retention.auditRetentionNotice: Audit and tamper records have a separate floor of the active general-retention window or 12 months, whichever is longer; ordinary activity retention does not remove them.

deleteNow.description: This issues a signed, one-time deletion instruction to your children's devices. It cannot retroactively erase a device that stays offline.
deleteNow.confirmBody: This action cannot be undone once devices acknowledge it.
deleteNow.issuedStatus: Deletion instruction issued and audited -- delivery status: {{status}}.
deleteNow.scopeNotice: Delete Now removes activity content only. It does not remove enrollment keys, policies, roles, or recovery configuration; full device or family removal is a separate, strongly confirmed action.
deleteNow.offlineNotice: A child device that stays offline cannot be reported as erased. Its deletion remains pending until the device can acknowledge the instruction.
deleteNow.externalCopyNotice: Delete Now does not erase encrypted exports or backups outside PCA-managed storage. Those copies must be removed using the storage provider's controls.
deleteNow.secureEraseNotice: PCA does not promise forensic-grade physical erasure on flash storage. Local encryption and best-effort platform/database cleanup reduce exposure without claiming more than the device can prove.

childWellbeing.noMessages: No custom wellbeing messages target this child yet.

activityTimeline.title: Activity Timeline
activityTimeline.description: A single, chronological, category-level view of this child's recent activity across every PCA feature -- distinct from the Audit log, which only records changes YOU made to settings, not the child's own activity.
activityTimeline.empty: No activity has been recorded for this child yet.

privacy.title: Privacy boundary
privacy.childDataNotice: Parent-visible monitoring copy refers to your children's devices and the active family policy; it is not a promise of universal visibility into every app or network.
privacy.serverNotice: PCA central services relay encrypted family data but do not hold a key that can read the activity.
privacy.notAUniversalView: Unavailable or unsupported evidence is reported as unavailable, not as zero activity or complete protection.

reports.title: Reports and coverage
reports.description: Reports show only evidence the child device and platform can lawfully and technically provide. Read each result with its source, coverage, precision, permission or capability state, and retention state.
reports.unavailable: Unavailable is a valid result. It does not mean zero activity.
reports.stale: This report may be stale or incomplete until the child device reconnects or the required permission is restored.
reports.appUsageOnly: App-usage duration does not reveal messages, searches, videos, or contacts inside the app.
reports.locationApproximate: Location is a coarse or last-seen safety state, not a continuous precise GPS trace.
reports.modeBEvents: PCA-controlled YouTube entries describe playback started, playback state observed, or a completed signal observed; they do not claim normal-app watch history.

transparency.title: What Parents Can See
transparency.intro: This page lists, in plain language, exactly what PCA lets you (the parent) see about your child's device, and what PCA never collects or shows to anyone -- including PCA itself.
transparency.scopeNotice: The categories below describe the active policy and the capabilities actually available on the child device. A limited or unavailable capability must remain visible as such.
transparency.visibleTitle: What you can see in this console

visible.appUsage: Which apps your child uses and for how long (category/app-level, using the device's own usage-tracking API where the platform provides one).
visible.webBrowsing: The domain/category of sites visited and whether they were allowed or blocked, when using PCA's own filtered browsing mode -- not every third-party browser your child could install.
visible.contentBlocks: A record that a site or app was blocked, its category, and the rule/reason -- never the raw blocked content itself.
visible.location: A coarse location state (e.g. "at a trusted zone", "last seen near X") at the accuracy level and frequency your family's policy sets -- never a continuous precise GPS trace beyond what you configure.
visible.eyeProtection: When an eye-rest reminder was shown -- never a camera image or any biometric measurement.
visible.prayerReminders: When a prayer reminder was scheduled and delivered.
visible.deviceStatus: Whether the device is online, its last sync time, and whether its protection is fully applied.
visible.policyChanges: A full audit trail of every setting change made by any family member (see the Audit page).
visible.youtube: Whether PCA-controlled YouTube events are available and, only in that player, playback events that began there; normal YouTube app watch history is not visible.
visible.wellbeing: Which parent-approved wellbeing messages or reminders are enabled for this child and their delivery state; message interaction content stays on the device.
visible.childRequests: Requests sent by your child (such as more time or an unblock request), their decision state, and the parent decision record.

transparency.notVisibleTitle: What PCA never collects or shows -- to anyone, including PCA

notVisible.messages: The content of messages, calls, or any other communication on the device.
notVisible.screenshots: Screenshots, screen recordings, or microphone/camera captures.
notVisible.biometrics: Camera frames, face images, or any biometric template -- the eye-protection feature only ever produces a coarse near/far distance signal, consumed on-device and never transmitted.
notVisible.preciseWithoutConsent: Continuous precise location beyond what your family's own policy requests.
notVisible.fullBrowsing: Full browsing history or page content outside PCA's own filtered browsing mode.
notVisible.thirdParty: Any activity from a third-party app or browser PCA has no legitimate access to.

transparency.encryptionNote: Everything above is end-to-end encrypted between your children's devices. PCA's servers relay encrypted data but hold no key that can read it -- see the Retention page for how long different categories are kept, and Security & Recovery for how your children's encryption keys work.
transparency.sdkNote: Third-party services this app relies on (crash reporting, payment processing, push-notification delivery) are listed with the specific data category each can access; PCA does not use advertising or tracking SDKs.

permissionsPolicy.title: App Permissions
permissionsPolicy.intro: This page explains every permission PCA's Android app can ask your device for, in plain language: which feature uses it, and exactly what data path it feeds. Nothing here is aspirational or a general industry disclosure -- this list is generated to match the permissions actually declared in the app's own manifest.
permissionsPolicy.scopeNotice: Declaring a permission here is a precondition for asking, not proof the app already uses it in the background: PCA still requests each dangerous permission through its own runtime consent screen at the exact moment the feature that needs it is used, and every feature keeps working (in a reduced form, never a fabricated one) if you decline.
permissionsPolicy.androidHeading: Permissions requested by the Android app

accessFineLocation.name: Precise location
accessFineLocation.purpose: Used by the Location feature for a child device you have turned on, to read a precise on-device GPS/network fix while the app is in the foreground. It is requested through its own runtime consent flow, never assumed just because it is declared here. The precise fix is encrypted on the device and only ever leaves it as an end-to-end encrypted payload your family's own devices can decrypt -- PCA's own servers cannot read it.

accessCoarseLocation.name: Approximate location
accessCoarseLocation.purpose: Requested together with precise location as the same foreground Location capability; if only this permission is granted, the app falls back to an approximate fix and additionally floors it to a roughly 1.1 km grid before it is ever saved, as a defense-in-depth step on top of whatever rounding Android itself already applies to a coarse fix.

accessBackgroundLocation.name: Location access while the app is in the background
accessBackgroundLocation.purpose: Lets the already-granted Location capability keep working when the app is not in the foreground (Android 10+ only). Checked live, never cached; Android requires this to be requested in its own separate runtime prompt after foreground location is already granted, and PCA follows that same two-step flow rather than bundling the two requests.

postNotifications.name: Post notifications
postNotifications.purpose: Used on Android 13+ to show the ordinary, dismissable Wellbeing "positive suggestion" notification. Checked before every notification is shown; if denied, the suggestion is simply not delivered -- the app never crashes or substitutes another delivery channel.

accessNetworkState.name: View network connections
accessNetworkState.purpose: A normal, not user-prompted permission used only to report honest Internet-connectivity status and to know when a family-sync attempt might succeed. It never gates any local, on-device protection -- those keep working offline regardless of this signal.

readPhoneState.name: Read phone call state
readPhoneState.purpose: Lets the app observe only whether a call is ringing, in progress, or idle, to support communication-exception timing features. It never reads phone numbers, contacts, call content, or audio; if this permission is unavailable, call-exception timing is simply reported as unavailable, never fabricated.

scheduleExactAlarm.name: Schedule exact alarms
scheduleExactAlarm.purpose: Used only to fire a prayer-time reminder at its real wall-clock moment; an inexact alarm could drift by minutes. On Android 12+ this is special access granted through Settings, not a runtime permission dialog.

foregroundService.name: Run a foreground service
foregroundService.purpose: Required to keep the Web Protection VPN's enforcement notification visible and non-hideable while the content-filtering tunnel is active. It does not itself grant the VPN -- your consent for the VPN tunnel is obtained separately through Android's own system dialog.

foregroundServiceSpecialUse.name: Foreground service (special use)
foregroundServiceSpecialUse.purpose: The Android 14+ foreground-service subtype required for the same Web Protection VPN enforcement notification as above; declared alongside the general foreground-service permission because newer Android versions require services to declare a specific subtype.

camera.name: Camera
camera.purpose: Used only in the foreground, one frame at a time, for on-device near/far proximity estimation in the Eye Protection feature. It is never used for face recognition or identity, no frame is ever saved to storage, and no image or video is ever transmitted anywhere -- processing happens entirely on the device. The permission request itself states this scope up front, and your family may decline it without losing any other PCA feature; devices without a camera still install and run PCA normally.

permissionsPolicy.encryptionNote: Whenever a permission above leads to data being sent to your family's parent console (for example, a location fix), the sync payload is end-to-end encrypted to your family's own devices before it ever leaves the child's device -- PCA's own server infrastructure cannot read it, the same encryption boundary described for every other category on the What Parents Can See page.
permissionsPolicy.exhaustiveNote: This list is exhaustive, not aspirational: it is generated to match android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml exactly. If a permission is not listed above, PCA's Android app does not declare it, and cannot request it.

recovery.description: Recovery material (the Recovery Secret) is never displayed by PCA infrastructure and is never shown here in readable form. This screen only lets the Owner start an authenticated recovery transaction.
recovery.secretDisclosureTitle: Before you create your Recovery Secret
recovery.secretDisclosureBody: PCA infrastructure never receives or stores this secret. Keep it offline and available to the family owner.
recovery.secretDisclosureWarning: If you lose the Recovery Secret and all active parent devices, family recovery is permanently impossible. PCA support cannot recover it; start a new family enrollment instead.
recovery.secretDisclosureAcknowledgement: I understand that losing both recovery paths permanently prevents recovery.

auth.registerSuccess: Check your email for a verification code.
auth.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
auth.verifySuccess: Your email is verified. Setting up your children's protection...
